name: Tempest weather station (metric)
summary: Weather from your WeatherFlow Tempest station via the Tempest API: conditions, temperature, humidity, wind, rain, pressure and UV, in metric units.
description: Reads your station's current conditions from the Tempest API (swd.weatherflow.com) with a personal access token; the station must be online and uploading to Tempest. Create the token at tempestwx.com → Settings → Data Authorizations. Replies are in metric units (°C, km/h, mm, hPa); for °F, mph, inches and inHg install Tempest weather station (imperial). The Tempest hub's local UDP broadcast is not used.
author: MeshHome

settings.label: Station ID
settings.help: The number in your station's address on tempestwx.com (tempestwx.com/station/12345), also shown in the Tempest app under Settings → Stations.

settings.label: Personal access token
settings.help: From tempestwx.com → Settings → Data Authorizations → Create Token. It gives read access to your stations.

reply.empty: The Tempest station reported no current conditions.
reply.unavailable: The Tempest service isn't answering right now.
